_note: Standalone episodes: no shared storyline, any order. hook_* are hypotheses (max 8 spoken words), not facts. sources are references to locate and verify, never trusted without reading the primary text. Do not state numbers from hooks (e.g. 43-second) until verified in the fact sheet. Status is tracked per language: each language is produced, scheduled and measured separately. Fact sheets are shared between languages (facts do not depend on language); scripts and visuals are written natively per language.
